title: Juicy Roasted Moroccan Chicken Rfissa
description: A velvety and light Moroccan dish featuring roasted chicken in a rich and creamy sauce, served in a traditional ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar, pound the onion, garlic, and ginger until well combined and slightly smooth.
In a large bowl, mix together the pounded onion mixture, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Transfer the chicken to a ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven with a tight-fitting lid.
Pour the single cream over the chicken and cover the tagine or Dutch oven with the lid.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is lightly browned.
Remove the tagine or Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
